description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter is available only in hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: milliseconds.
